definitions.gloss: forthcoming publication; book due out soon
definitions.explanation: A book or publication scheduled to come out soon, or one that has just been released. Common in publishing and bookstore contexts. Composed of {近|きん} (near) + {刊|かん} (publication).

examples.japanese: {近刊|きんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: An announcement of forthcoming books arrived.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近刊|きんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to that author's forthcoming book.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}→出版社：11765_shuppansha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近刊|きんかん}⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}→掲載：08993_keisai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The publisher's website lists next month's forthcoming titles.

notes:
Composed of {近|きん} (near) + {刊|かん} (publication). Used in publishing and bookselling to announce books due out soon.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {近刊|きんかん}⟦{予告|よこく}→予告：08379_yokoku⟧: announcement of forthcoming books
- {近刊|きんかん}⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧: forthcoming-titles guide
- {近刊|きんかん}⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧: scheduled for upcoming release

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新刊|しんかん}→新刊：16466_shinkan⟧: new publication — a book that has just been released
- ⟦{既刊|きかん}→既刊：17885_kikan⟧: already published — books already in print
